title: Individual & Family Dental Plans 2026 (Delta Dental of North Carolina — Preventive Plan, Enhanced Plan, Premium Plan; non-EHB brochure)
publisher: Delta Dental of North Carolina, 3737 Glenwood Avenue, Suite 320, Raleigh, NC 27612

scope.geography: North Carolina ("Any North Carolina resident can enroll.")
scope.population: Individual and family (off-exchange / non-EHB) purchasers; North Carolina residents and their eligible dependents
scope.plan_type: PPO (Delta Dental PPO / Delta Dental Premier / Out of Network; three plan designs)
scope.network: Delta Dental PPO Network™ and Delta Dental Premier Network®; Nonparticipating Dentist paid on Delta Dental's Nonparticipating Dentist Fee

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF→text via a summarizing sub-model limited to ~125-character quotes; the brochure is 4 pages with printed page numbers). Table cells were cross-checked across three fetches; cells that disagreed are recorded as AMBIGUOUS with both readings.
reuse_terms: not stated (no copyright line returned; trademark marks printed: "Delta Dental PPO Network™", "Delta Dental Premier Network®"). The brochure is not the contract: "The Policy prevails if discrepancies are noted between this brochure and the Policy." Policy form INVD-100-Delta-2026-NC.
access_limits: The underlying individual Policy (form INVD-100-Delta-2026-NC) is not posted publicly; a search for the form number found nothing. Only this brochure and the insurer's web page https://deltadentalnc.com/exceptionsandreductions are available.

The exceptionsandreductions web page names policy forms QINVD-100-Delta-2022-NC / -2023-NC (EHB) and INDV-100-Delta-2022-NC / -2023-NC (non-EHB), not the 2026 form; its limitation sentences are therefore recorded as AMBIGUOUS for plan year 2026.

The fetch tool's sub-model returned inconsistent cells for the Preventive Plan Basic/Major rows, the Enhanced Plan Major row and the Orthodontic Premier/Out-of-Network cells across three calls; those are flagged AMBIGUOUS (see facts). Page attribution for the exclusions list (p. 3 vs p. 4) also varied.

Blue Cross and Blue Shield of North Carolina: no Dental Blue for Individuals benefit booklet/policy PDF is publicly linked from bcbsnc.com (only a quote tool and an undated limitations web page); the 'Dental Blue Policy (Rev. 9/24)' PDF found on myrxtoolkit.com is a BlueCross BlueShield of SOUTH Carolina policy and was rejected.

facts.basis: consecutive months enrolled; major services including endodontic, periodontic, major restorative, relines and repairs, prosthodontic; waivable with 12 months immediately preceding dental coverage (initial enrollment only)
facts.quote: will not be covered until after a person is enrolled in the dental plan for 12 consecutive months.
facts.notes: Full passage: "Preventative and basic services will be covered with no waiting periods. Major services including endodontic services, periodontic services, major restorative services, relines and repairs, and prosthodontic services will not be covered until after a person is enrolled in the dental plan for 12 consecutive months. For the initial enrollment only, the waiting periods(s) can be waived for all services if the enrollee was covered for at least 12 months under the immediately preceding dental plan."
